note: Declared ordering policy for the takeable-work projection over soveraeign-ticket/v1 instances. The queue is a projection and is rebuildable from the tickets alone; it introduces no standing, priority authority, or private state. Changing the order changes what work is offered first, so the policy is declared data rather than code.
kinds_outside_dispatch_note: A story is told by an actor in a role and walked through a scenario; it is never taken as work, so it never enters the takeable queue and never blocks or unblocks anything in it. Its asks point at the stubs and bits that are.

next_action.DEMOTED: repair against the defeating observation and re-enter at PROPOSED
next_action.BUILT_SELF_TESTED_NOT_WITNESSED: run the Red lane and seek an independent witness
next_action.CHARTERED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: build the smallest change that satisfies the visible case
next_action.DECLARED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: write the charter and the machine-checkable contract
next_action.PROPOSED: declare the owned boundary in the repository
next_action.OPEN: draft the obligation, priors, and closure contract
next_action.RATIFIED: no further action at this gate

unblock_note: An unblock request is takeable work: it is served by the tier it names in requested_from, and it sorts up because the ticket it holds counts toward unblocks. Blocked is never a ticket status; it is a held-by edge to an unblock ticket (AGENTS.md, Blocked edge is not blocked frontier).
provision_routes_note: Which tiers may serve each provision. Declared data, not authority: serving a grant or judgement still needs the live grant the kernel checks at the transition.
